mutants.required_behavior: state must be isolated by (tenant_id, user_id, route, window_index); two users in one tenant+route must not share a budget
mutants.detect_hint: assert a second user in the same tenant+route+window is still allowed after the first user is exhausted

mutants.defect_class: retry_after equals remaining seconds to window end
mutants.required_behavior: a denied request's retry_after is the remaining seconds until the current window ends, not the full window
mutants.detect_hint: assert the exact retry_after value on a denial (e.g. 50.0 at t=10 in a 60s window)

mutants.defect_class: exact next-window boundary opens a new window
mutants.required_behavior: a request whose timestamp lands exactly on the next window boundary uses the new window
mutants.detect_hint: assert a request at the exact boundary timestamp is allowed after the previous window was exhausted
